items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1958-11-14
items.q: Well, that was Capitano Chivarillo. Nothing but Spanish. Nothing. They speak to me in Spanish, the language of the class that was going on.

ctx.x: Well, it was nothing but French. And then the next day, it was maybe the Spanish class. Well, that was Capitano Chivarillo. Nothing but Spanish. Nothing. They speak to me in Spanish, the language of the class that was going on. And Herman Gessner. Herman Gessner teaches. That must be his grandson that is teaching at Tulane. Yes, I've heard that name. Yes, Herman Gessner. Well, then him, he was Spanish, German. And nothing but German. They called me and they speak to me in German and asked me things in German. No…
So you had to learn all of those languages too?
